description: Navigate into the 'datatools' Python library source code to understand the process_data() function's actual parameters. The workspace contains data_processor.py which uses incorrect parameters (mode='strict', ignore_errors=True). Use Go to Definition (F12) or Ctrl+Click on 'process_data' to jump to the library source code. Read the actual function signature in the library's source files to discover the correct parameter names. Create a new file called 'test_datatools.py' in /home/ga/workspace/library_task/ that demonstrates correct usage with proper parameters based on what you learned from reading the source code. Include comments explaining the correct parameters.
